Pendency of passport applications
*21. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of passport
applications are pending in the country,
especially in Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, whether it is proposed to set
up one more passport office at Madurai,
considering the heavy workload at Trichy
Office, to clear the backlog;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

*22. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) what measures are being taken by
Government to modernise the Postal
Department;

Agreement between India and Nepal
*23. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI LALIT SURI:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether during the recent visit of
Nepalese Prime Minister to New Delhi, any
agreement or Memorandum of Under-
standing was signed, extending Indian
support to fight the Maoist insurgency in
Nepal; and
(b) the details of specific issues
discussed and the decisions arrived at as a
result thereof and the follow up action taken
so far by the two Governments to
implement them ?

Atomic power plants in the country
*24. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the quantum of atomic energy
produced in the country and its percentage
on the total generation of electricity;
(b) the target production of atomic
energy during the Tenth Five Year Plan
period;
(c) whether Government have any fresh
proposals of atomic power plants in the
country; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Rehabilitation of bonded labour in
Tamil Nadu
*25. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the large scale practice of bonded labour
in the Redhill area of Thiruvallur district
of Tamil Nadu;
(b) whether his Ministry has received
the National Commission for Women’s
report on public hearings on the subject;
and
(c) the follow up action taken to secure
the release and the rehabilitation of the
victims and the punishment of those guilty
of these criminal activities?
Vallarpadam International Container
Trans-shipment Terminal
*26. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the Vallarpadam International
Container Trans-shipment Terminal, which
is Kerala’s dream project is waiting for
approval from his Ministry for the last five
months;
(b) if so, the reasons for delay on
Government’s part in sanctioning the
project;
(c) whether Government are aware of
the fact that as the Indian ports lack full
fledged trans-shipment terminal facilities,
the major chunk of Indian container traffic
is directed to foreign hubs like Colombo,
Singapore and Dubai; and
(d) the efforts Government propose to
make to accord an early sanction of the
project?
Global Positioning System
*27. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
is planning to provide Global Positioning
System (GPS) for motor vehicles in Delhi,
Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, etc.;
(b) if so, the details of the System and
how it would help the people;
(c) by when this would be implemented
in Delhi;
(d) whether his Ministry is also working
on National Spatial Data infrastructure
alongwith GPS; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

Employment in Agro and Rural
Industries
†70. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons employed in
the agro based and rural industries and the
percentage of persons working in above
industries out of total employed persons;
(b) whether it is a fact that the employ-
ment opportunities in the both the above
category of industries have declined;
and
(c) if so, the details of the measures
being taken to promote the agro and rural
industries and increase the job-
opportunities therein?
Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana
71. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated to Uttar Pradesh

under the Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana
during the last three years; and
(b) the details of amount utilised as well
as unutilised out of the above?
Promotion of ARIs in Uttar Pradesh
72. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of steps Government have
taken to promote agro-based industries in
Uttar Pradesh;
(b) the details of the rural industries
under implementation in the State; and
(c) the details of funds allotted,
sanctioned, released and utilised for this
purpose during the last three years?
PMRY in Uttar Pradesh
73. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:

18

(a) whether Government have set any
target for generating employment
opportunities during the last three years
under the Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana
in Uttar Pradesh; and
(b) if so, the details thereof indicating
the actual achievements made in this
regard?
Boosing of ARIs
74. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agro and rural
industries in the country are in doldrums
and not being able to compete in the open
market with their products;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to help the agro and
rural industries to sustain and grow?
Establishment of ARIs
75. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any plan to establish agriculture
based industries, provide technical training
for it as well as to provide financial
assistance for the establishment of
Industries to farmers in order to bring
improvement in the economic conditions
of the farmers;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government are
considering to formulate any plan in this
regard in the near future?
Technical viability of nuclear fusion
76. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether India is thinking of joining
the highly ambitious project promoted by
a select band of advanced countries to build
a plant to demonstrate technical viability
of nuclear fusion as a source of energy;
(b) if so, the details of the project and
the countries that are involved in the
project; and
(c) the financial commitment required
to become a member of the programme?
Mineral production in the country
77. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have recently approved Rs. 4000 crores of
FDI in the mining sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is not a fact that due to
obsolete technology by Indian minerals the
country has been deficient in high value
minerals; and
(d) the total mineral production in the
country during the last three years, year-
wise?
Private investments in Mines
78. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have allowed
private investment in mines and minerals
sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
